brief:
An-Najah National University has launched "Voice of the Earth," a short film competition featuring artificial intelligence, in collaboration with the UAE-Palestinian Friendship Club, according to Ma'an Wire. The initiative combines filmmaking with AI technology to create new forms of creative expression.

Details about submission deadlines, judging criteria, and prize categories were not specified in the available information about the competition.
title: An-Najah University launches AI-driven short film competition with UAE-Palestinian friendship club
